rows.note: Use 傭兵 specifically for someone hired to fight in an armed conflict for pay.

example.english: A mercenary is a foreigner hired to fight.

rows.jyutping: gin3 cin2 hoi1 ngaan5 ge3 jan4
rows.note: For the general money-motivated-person sense, this is the all-purpose choice rather than a military term.

example.english: They’re a mercenary sort of person who does everything for money.
example.jyutping: gin3 cin2 hoi1 ngaan5 ge3 jan4
